SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:00:00Z', v.created_at) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS n
        FROM robotaxi_vehicles v WHERE v.visibility = 'public' AND (EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM trips t JOIN submissions s ON s.id = t.submission_id
    WHERE t.robotaxi_vehicle_id = v.id AND t.superseded_by IS NULL AND s.status IN ('pending', 'approved')
  )
    OR (v.origin = 'sighting' AND ((v.vin IS NOT NULL AND v.vin <> '')
                                          OR v.approval_basis IS NOT NULL))) AND (lower(trim(v.model)) = 'cybercab' OR v.approval_basis IS NOT NULL) AND lower(trim(COALESCE(v.model, ''))) NOT IN ('model y', 'model_y', 'modely') AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM robotaxi_vehicles duplicate WHERE duplicate.visibility = 'public' AND (EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM trips t JOIN submissions s ON s.id = t.submission_id
    WHERE t.robotaxi_vehicle_id = duplicate.id AND t.superseded_by IS NULL AND s.status IN ('pending', 'approved')
  )
    OR (duplicate.origin = 'sighting' AND ((duplicate.vin IS NOT NULL AND duplicate.vin <> '')
                                          OR duplicate.approval_basis IS NOT NULL))) AND (lower(trim(duplicate.model)) = 'cybercab' OR duplicate.approval_basis IS NOT NULL) AND lower(trim(COALESCE(duplicate.model, ''))) NOT IN ('model y', 'model_y', 'modely')
    AND (duplicate.created_at < v.created_at OR (duplicate.created_at = v.created_at AND duplicate.id < v.id))
    AND ((upper(trim(COALESCE(v.vin, ''))) <> '' AND upper(trim(COALESCE(v.vin, ''))) = upper(trim(COALESCE(duplicate.vin, ''))))
      OR (upper(replace(replace(trim(COALESCE(v.license_plate, '')), '-', ''), ' ', '')) <> '' AND upper(replace(replace(trim(COALESCE(v.license_plate, '')), '-', ''), ' ', '')) = upper(replace(replace(trim(COALESCE(duplicate.license_plate, '')), '-', ''), ' ', ''))))) AND v.created_at >= ? AND v.created_at < ? GROUP BY hour

SELECT first_seen_date AS date, lower(model) AS model, COUNT(*) AS n FROM dmv_av_vehicles
      WHERE in_baseline = 0 AND first_seen_date >= ? AND first_seen_date < ? AND lower(model) IN ('cybercab', 'model y') GROUP BY date, lower(model)

SELECT MIN(o.observed_at) AS first FROM submissions s JOIN vehicle_observations o ON o.submission_id = s.id
 LEFT JOIN robotaxi_vehicles pv ON pv.id = o.robotaxi_vehicle_id AND pv.visibility = 'public' AND (EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM trips t JOIN submissions s ON s.id = t.submission_id
    WHERE t.robotaxi_vehicle_id = pv.id AND t.superseded_by IS NULL AND s.status IN ('pending', 'approved')
  )
    OR (pv.origin = 'sighting' AND ((pv.vin IS NOT NULL AND pv.vin <> '')
                                          OR pv.approval_basis IS NOT NULL))) WHERE 
  s.submission_type = 'vehicle_sighting' AND s.status = 'approved' AND s.evidence_type = 'photo'
  AND o.evidence_ref IS NOT NULL AND o.public_id IS NOT NULL
  AND s.submitted_at > datetime('now', '-30 days') AND (o.robotaxi_vehicle_id IS NULL OR pv.id IS NOT NULL)

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:00:00Z', o.observed_at) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS n
        FROM submissions s JOIN vehicle_observations o ON o.submission_id = s.id
 LEFT JOIN robotaxi_vehicles pv ON pv.id = o.robotaxi_vehicle_id AND pv.visibility = 'public' AND (EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM trips t JOIN submissions s ON s.id = t.submission_id
    WHERE t.robotaxi_vehicle_id = pv.id AND t.superseded_by IS NULL AND s.status IN ('pending', 'approved')
  )
    OR (pv.origin = 'sighting' AND ((pv.vin IS NOT NULL AND pv.vin <> '')
                                          OR pv.approval_basis IS NOT NULL))) WHERE 
  s.submission_type = 'vehicle_sighting' AND s.status = 'approved' AND s.evidence_type = 'photo'
  AND o.evidence_ref IS NOT NULL AND o.public_id IS NOT NULL
  AND s.submitted_at > datetime('now', '-30 days') AND (o.robotaxi_vehicle_id IS NULL OR pv.id IS NOT NULL) AND o.observed_at >= ? AND o.observed_at < ? GROUP BY hour

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:00:00Z', observed_at) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS n
        FROM camera_detections WHERE 1=1 AND observed_at >= ? AND observed_at < ? GROUP BY hour
SELECT snapshot_date FROM dmv_snapshots ORDER BY snapshot_date
